title: Source-open factorization of the normalized inverse open comparison
statement: Let B be a commutative ring, and use the strict-tower operations of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], the open adjunction and compositors of [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], and the specified inverse comparison betaInv of [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Let s:V→P, b:P→W, q:P→S, k:V→W, r:V→S, i:S→T, p:W→T satisfy s≫b=k, s≫q=r, k≫p=r≫i and q≫i=b≫p. Assume s,b,k,i are open immersions. For every M in D(Towers(B,S)), betaInv(r,k,i,p) at M equals the inverse open compositor J_k→J_s J_b (transported along s≫b=k), followed by J_b of J_s applied to the inverse-image compositor G_r→G_q G_s (transported along s≫q=r), followed by J_b of the open counit J_s G_s→identity at G_q M, followed by betaInv(q,b,i,p) at M. No properness, quasi-compactness, closedness or cartesianness is assumed.

proof.text: Prove the source-square compositor equation first for an arbitrary PullbackCoherentSystem: apply its associativity law to the triples (s,q,i) and (s,b,p), with the supplied square commutativity; a generic category cancellation lemma combines the two equations. Expand systemSquare only in this abstract setting. Specialize this proved generic equation to pullbackSystem B, identifying squareG with systemSquare by squareG_system and reflexive gCompEq with gComp. This avoids kernel normalization across large concrete derived functor terms.

Transpose the proposed factorization under the open adjunction of s≫b. The normalized jComp is conjugate to gComp, so the conjugate unit identity replaces this transpose, after composing with gComp, by the transpose under the composite open adjunction. Its Hom equivalence is the composite of the two open Hom equivalences. Naturality and the counit-transpose identity cancel the inserted counit. The remaining expression is gComp(s,q) followed by G_s of the defining transpose of betaInv(q,b,i,p). Naturality of gComp moves the open unit across, and the source-square equation gives precisely the defining transpose of betaInv(s≫q,s≫b,i,p). Cancel the invertible compositor and apply injectivity of the Hom equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem betaInv_source_factorization {V P W S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : V ⟶ P) (b : P ⟶ W) (q : P ⟶ S)
    (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (i : S ⟶ T) (p : W ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (hk : s ≫ b = k) (hr : s ≫ q = r)
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (h₀ : q ≫ i = b ≫ p) (M : Derived B S) :
    (betaInv B r k i p h.symm).app M =
      ((jComp B s b ≪≫ jCongr B hk).inv.app ((G B r).obj M)) ≫
      (J B b).map ((J B s).map
        ((((eqToIso (congrArg (G B) hr)).symm) ≪≫ gComp B s q).hom.app M) ≫
          (jAdj B s).counit.app ((G B q).obj M)) ≫
      (betaInv B q b i p h₀).app M
